A reference that must be guess-proof belongs to a gift nobody owns where there is no account for support to tie it to at all. The ReceiptReference column is already 256 wide and its unique index covers the whole string so a longer anonymous form needed no schema change. Measured: 1 donation exists in the production database and it has an owner so 0 pre-existing ownerless receipts carry the old 30 bits and the forward-only generator leaves no residue. The read path is still load-bearing for a better reason that the register does not state: an anonymous gift completes asynchronously after its payment and appears in no history so this route is the only way its giver can learn the money arrived which is why the fix had to preserve it rather than scope it away.
